citation: Honma M, et al. 2019. Effect of acute total sleep deprivation on plasma melatonin, cortisol and metabolite rhythms in females. European Journal of Neuroscience 51:366.
protocol: Acute total sleep deprivation (about 92 h in the laboratory, 70-h sampling protocol) vs baseline sleep; plasma cortisol and melatonin sampled throughout; night-time (00:00-06:00) values in text
population: n=12 healthy young females, age 25 +/- 4 y, BMI 24.9 +/- 3.6 kg/m2
note: Doubtful: the peak-cortisol numbers are in text, but the uncertainty label is in the figure legend ('All data are shown as mean +/- SEM'). Most cortisol and melatonin series are figures. Check the sampling interval before use.
